newsitem.title: USA: Dataworks sees weak Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Dataworks sees weak Q2 results.

text.p: DataWorks Corp said Monday it expects revenues for its second quarter will fall below analysts' expectations.
The company said in a statement revenues for the quarter, ended June 30, will be slightly above the $15.3 million of revenues it posted in the comparable year-ago quarter.

It said net income will likely approximate the $1.2 million it posted in the year-ago quarter even though gross margin percentages for the quarter are expected to be less than the gross margin percentages for the prior year's quarter.
The company attributed the lower than expected revenues to timing delays on customer orders.
Analysts had predicted the company would earn $0.24 a share for the quarter, according to First Call.
